programs.description: The life of a struggling actor changes when two individuals take advantage of him and try to dupe him. However, he strives to overcome his obstacles.
Raghu, a responsible youth, faces the wrath of the villagers as he is the son of a lazy postman. However, Raghu's life takes a turn when he encounters Yasin Mubarak, a notorious man.
A wealthy heiress plans to implicate her former boyfriend for her murder by hiring an assassin. Things take a turn when a thief enters the house at the same time.
Ram does not believe in everlasting love and this ideology does not go down well with Jaanu. When Abhishek, a police officer, asks him the reason, he tells him about Rooba, his former lover.

After Subramanian has to leave his aged father alone to go to Russia, he returns with a robot to take care of him. Even though hesitant at first, his father soon develops a strong bond with the robot.
After being forsaken by his mother in a temple, Aravindan, a five-year-old boy, is taken in by a hotelier. Against all odds, Aravindan clings to the hope of reuniting with his mother.
After moving into a hostel in Bangalore for their engineering course, three teenagers get into a terrible brawl with their seniors. To exact revenge, they decide to befriend a gangster.
Barroz, a loyal servant, is compelled by magic to guard Cristovao da Gama's treasure for four centuries, waiting for a true heir to claim it.
Four engineering students battle their professor's supernatural schemes to control the campus, encountering cursed gadgets and bizarre scenarios along the way.
Rajesh, a gold dealer, lends some gold jewelry for a village wedding, unaware of the betrayal ahead. However, the bride's husband plans to keep the gold and kill Rajesh.
Unni Kesavan's carefree and rebellious life is challenged when childhood friend Indira returns, bringing warmth, reflection and a chance for personal growth.
Three inseparable friends devise an ingenious ploy to fund a destitute woman's marriage. However, destiny plays a cruel game after an unscrupulous individual steal their hard-earned funds.
Vishnu, a teacher, gets transferred to a village where he loses his son in an accident. He decides to hide this news from his wife, who is in prison, till she is released.

Jaison, a teenager, has a crush on Keerthy, but she does not reciprocate his feelings. To make things worse, he gets in trouble with Ravi, the new teacher who is liked by everyone, especially Keerthy.
A young aspiring film director who seeks to make his directorial debut decides to use a real-life gangster as inspiration for his first movie.
An affluent man is called upon to hand over his vast plot of land to the government. However, situations take a turn when he brings the influential Neyyattinkara Gopan into the picture.
In the coastal village of Marlur, Ashoka's innocent crush sparks rumours of ghostly possession, creating comedic chaos and unexpected twists.
An unexpected twist in the tale of taxi driver Shanmughan's life puts his fondness for his old car to the ultimate test.
A historic rifle club in the Western Ghats becomes the centre of a fight for survival when a dangerous arms dealer and his gang come seeking revenge.
A historic rifle club in the Western Ghats becomes the centre of a fight for survival when a dangerous arms dealer and his gang come seeking revenge.
Vidyadharan, a clockmaker and widower, lives only for his daughter. However, his life takes a turn for the worse when he kills a thug, whom he suspected of murdering a village girl.
Returning to his village after the war to meet his family, Aloshy discovers that his brothers are working as henchmen for a local businessman and plotting against his father.
A group of corrupt politicians fight to acquire an old palace. However, things take a turn when the court rules in favour of Mithran and Joseph.

Apoorvan, a school dropout, aspires to become a renowned scientist and tries various experiments. While his friends Babumon and Chopra help him, the three often land in trouble due to their behaviour.
An uneducated and noisy simpleton, Mike Philippose, arrives in a city as an organ donor for an old astrophysicist. Soon, he changes the lives of everyone around him.
Lal Krishna, an eccentric criminal lawyer, defends the woman accused of Chinthamani's murder. However, he learns that there is more to the story and decides to dispense justice in his own way.
When a vicious villain sets out to claim nine sacred books that hold the secret to immortality, the guardian of the ninth book ties a happy-go-lucky orphan's destiny to the quest to protect them.
A senior cop and a new recruit are forced to work together through a tense night shift, confronting danger and personal dilemmas that reveal deep cracks in the system.
When a young woman befriends a man her brother disapproves of, tangled feelings and assumptions set off a series of misjudgements, personal dilemmas, and awkward truths.

Johnson, the honourable son of a dreaded local thug, decides to erase the bad image of his father in society. He becomes a police officer and fights to bring criminals to justice.
Ajit, an anchor in Kolkata, meets Krishnapriya, who has lost her husband under mysterious circumstances. However, things become complicated when he falls for her while helping to find her spouse.
Chandrahasan, a truck driver, falls in love with Indrani and gets married to her. His life takes an unexpected turn when his best friend kidnaps Indrani, and he sets out to rescue her.
A man proposes to his close friend on the night before her wedding. However, he incurs the wrath of her older brothers when he elopes with her.
Thoma belongs to the Palaparambil family, which is disliked by the locals due to his father's actions. However, he comes up with a plan to portray his greedy father as a charitable person.
Baba Kalyani, a police officer, travels to Kochi to uncover a terrorist conspiracy. He must not only work on the case but also deal with old rivals who are hell-bent on settling scores with him.
Major Mukund Varadarajan, a commissioned officer in the Rajput Regiment of the Indian Army, conducts a counterterrorism operation while being deployed to Jammu and Kashmir.
Anand, a part-time investigator, embarks on a quest to unravel the mysterious death of a law student. However, his investigation leads him to confront his own demons.
When his father dies, Chandran is forced to go abroad to earn money to pay his father's dues. On a holiday to India, he meets his childhood lover and hopes to rekindle the relationship.

Kasthuri moves to a different city to escape from a man, who has an eye on her will. However, her life is in danger when he sends his thugs in search of her.
Shivaramakrishnan is a government employee who struggles to make ends meet. In order to earn some quick money, he and his friends start a daycare centre, which proves to be even more disastrous.
As investigations begin after a secretary's mysterious death, a minister is murdered, revealing a tangled web of deception and long-buried secrets.
After being forced to quit his own academy, Vishnu, a choreographer, comes across a group of talented dancers. He decides to take them under his wing and train them to be the best in the business.
Gopan, a tourist guide, issues a statement against his rival, Kuriyachan, regarding a human trafficking case. However, Kuriyachan seeks revenge against Gopan.
After one of them falls inside a dangerous pit in the Guna Caves, a group of childhood friends muster courage to rescue him out of a space from where a return is next to impossible.
A renegade operative competes with the clock to prevent a nuclear disaster.
A health worker in Wayanad copes with personal issues while caring for his bedridden brother. However, his quiet life is shattered when an armed fugitive demands shelter from the police.
Two friends who hail from cinema industry and pursue two separate dreams, navigate through different phase of their life, both hilarious and sentimental.

When wildlife photographer Dijo saves a young native boy, Thammi, from the clutches of a corrupt police officer, he unwittingly sparks a perilous quest for justice, putting his own life at risk.
Upon falling in love, Tomy and Amalu, two dogs, expect babies together against the wishes of their families. However, when they decide to run away, Amalu gets kidnapped, creating more problems.
Fed up with the fast-paced city life, Ramdas and his wife decide to move to a quiet bungalow on the outskirts of the city. However, some strange happenings in the surrounding put their lives at risk.
In the densely populated city of Cochin, a couple struggles through the process of finding the right fertility treatment for them.
Determined to seek justice, Sara Mohammed, a girl who is blind and a talented sculptor, joins hands with a disbarred lawyer as she goes up against her aggressor, the son of a business tycoon.
Seasoned cop Abraham Ozler delves into an enigmatic cold case, sparking a relentless pursuit of a cunning serial killer.
When 18 children are abducted and found dead, Mark, a police officer, races to catch the criminals. With only 18 hours left, he must confront powerful foes and use unconventional tactics to succeed.
When the daughter of a minister gets kidnapped, Christy is called upon to rescue her. Although he manages to save her, he himself gets embroiled in the kidnapper's murder.
A police constable reprimands his son for cheating on his school exams. However, he finds himself resorting to similar tactics when he takes a test that could land him a promotion.

Jeevan is a huge fan of Sneha, a popular actress and when she arrives in his village for a movie shoot, the former is under the illusion that they are already married and kidnaps her.
Siddharth often has problems with his wife Anjali owing to his short temper. Things take an unexpected turn when they get involved with a gangster.
Mukundan faces many challenges when he has to solve all his financial liabilities just with the income he gets by running a garage.
Kalarikkal Achuthankutty and Pattarumatathil Najeeb are best friends and run an event management company. But soon they part ways because Najeeb secretly marries Achuthankutty's sister Athira.
After a theatre group's party, their sole actress is subjected to a crime from one of the men. Stories unravel, suspicions surface and clamour ensues as a meeting is called to reach a consensus.
Sreehari has returned home from Paris after six years. He tries to settle some scores and clear misunderstandings with his old friends before leaving his village.
While investigating mysterious suicides in a village, a sub-inspector of police realises that they are murders in reality.
The disastrous floods in Kerala in 2018 bring about fatal implications for every individual. Later, people from different backgrounds cooperate to weather the disaster.
As they try to bury a loved one, the flood ruins a family's heartfelt farewell and compels them to face deep hidden secrets and lies that challenge their sense of unity.
